in_marathi.name: Navratan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navratan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navratan is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Nine Gems'. In Hindu mythology, Navratnas refer to nine precious gems: Ruby, Diamond, Emerald, Pearl, Coral, Turquoise, Topaz, Conch Shell, and Crystal. These gems are believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
